fields.title: 📖 Ibn Baṭṭah: The foundation is holding fast to the Jamāʿah
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Baṭṭah al-ʿUkbarī** said:

> ***“Ibn Baṭṭah presented holding fast to the Jamāʿah and avoiding division as a mighty principle of the Sunnah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Manhaj is not chaos and going alone. The path of the Sunnah is attachment to the truth, the Jamāʿah and transmission.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Baṭṭah, al-Ibānah al-Kubrā, Bāb: Dhikr al-Amr bi-Luzūm al-Jamāʿah.
